correctness.rationale: Kharoof–Lai Proposition 3.16 gives carrier dimension equals real nullity of the facet compatibility matrix minus one. Proposition 3.8 says the support map is a bundle scenario discrete over vertices; Proposition 3.10 guarantees supported n- and (n-1)-cells are precisely the proper dimensional lifts. On a closed manifold the pulled-back orientation local system orients each base facet locally and its two adjacent n-simplex sides oppositely. Row/column sign changes therefore identify the complete integer twisted top cellular boundary with the integer facet matrix. Since no supported cells exist above dimension n, H_n with pulled-back local coefficients equals its integral kernel, whose rank equals real nullity. The pulled-back orientation double cover yields the negative rational deck eigenspace, without an integral splitting claim. In a finite cover, adjacent lifted facets enforce a constant weight on each connected covering component; the only remaining equation is sum_j d_j a_j=1, so the whole distribution polytope is a simplex and twisted top homology Z^c. Independent 6-vertex RP2 exact ranks 10 ordinary vs 9 twisted, and direct block-copy checks 1..5, corroborate the nonorientable distinction.
